🔒 IL SB3410 — Illinois Funds Legal Help for Inmates

The state is allocating $2.5 million to the Illinois Prison Project to provide legal support, representation, and educational resources to incarcerated individuals within Illinois Department of Corrections.

July 2, 2026: Pursuant to Senate Rule 3-9(b) / Referred to Assignments.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://ilga.gov/Legislation/BillStatus?DocNum=3410&GAID=18&DocTypeID=SB&LegId=166340&SessionID=114
